title: Маркеры Предыстории (Before / After)
description: Выбери правильную форму (Какое действие было ПЕРВЫМ?).

items.question: I (finished / had finished) my homework before I went to bed.
I had finished my homework before I (had gone / went) to bed.
After she (cleaned / had cleaned) the room, she watched TV.
After she had cleaned the room, she (watched / had watched) TV.
We (ate / had eaten) dinner after we had played tennis.
We ate dinner after we (played / had played) tennis.
When I (arrived / had arrived), the train had left.
When I arrived, the train (left / had left).
By the time he (came / had come), we had finished the work.
By the time he came, we (finished / had finished) the work.
